verses.1: And these were the rulers of their fathers. They became kings along with me during the reign of Artaxerxes, the king of Babylon.
verses.2: The sons of Pinchas were taken away from the sons of Itamar Daniel, and from the sons of David Hattush.
verses.3: From the sons of Shekhaniyah, from the sons of Parosh, from Zekhayyah. Together with them, there were also a hundred and fifty people who were remembered in history.
verses.4: From the children of Pachath Moab, Eliehoaiyin, son of Zerahya; and with him were their ancestors.
verses.5: From the descendants of Shekhanya, son of Yahziyael, and with him were three hundred men.
verses.6: And from the descendants of Adin, there was a servant named Jonathan. With him were fifty men.
verses.7: And from the descendants of Eilam, there was She’shaia, son of Atalya. And with him were seventy men.
verses.8: And from the descendants of Shephtiyah Zevadya, son of Mikhael, and with him were those who remembered.
verses.9: From the descendants of Joab: Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him Mataiim and Shimon. There were also ten others who were mentioned in the text.
verses.10: And from the descendants of Shlomith, son of Josipia, along with him, there were one hundred and sixty men.
verses.11: And from the sons of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai; and with him were forty and seventy men who remembered.
verses.12: And from the descendants of Azgad, Yochanan, the youngest son, and with him were one hundred and ten men.
verses.13: And from the descendants of Adonikam, there were others. Their names were Eliphelet Yeiyael and Shemaiah. Together with them, there were also sixty other men who were remembered in history.
verses.14: And from the descendants of B’goy, there are Uthai and Zakhru; along with them, there are seventy other people who are also remembered.
verses.15: And we went to the river that flows into Ahava. We stayed there for three days. But among the people and the priests, as well as among the descendants of Levi, I didn’t find anyone there.
verses.16: And I will send Eliezer to Ariel לשמיה, and to Elnanan, and to Yarib. Also, I will send them to Elnanan, Natan, and Zekhariah. And also to Meshulam Rishim, Yoiyarib, and Elnanan the Wise.
verses.17: And I commanded them to go to the place called Kaspia. I spoke to them, asking them to bring us servants to serve in our house.
verses.18: And they brought to us, by the hand of our God, someone who is wise among all the children of Israel. His name was Sheriya, along with his sons and brothers. There were ten of them in total.
verses.19: And his descendants will be saved from the wickedness of his brothers and their children. There will be forty of them.
verses.20: And from those who were given by David and the priests for the service of the Levites, there were also many gifts. All of them were buried in their tombs.
verses.21: And I will call upon the river Ahava to pray before our God, so that He may show us the right path for us to follow, and to cleanse us and all our possessions.
verses.22: For I have sought help from the king of Heaven and from the gods for our sake. As we said to the king, “The hand of our God will be upon all those who seek evil, and it will protect us from all those who try to harm us.”
verses.23: And we asked our God for help regarding this matter. But he refused to help us.
verses.24: And I divided among the priests twenty-two thousand for Shéribya, the accountants. And with them were ten others from their families.
verses.25: And I will take away from them all their money, their gold, and all their goods. These were the possessions of our God’s house. The king, his advisors, his officials, and all the Israelites who were found there were also taken away.
verses.26: And I weighed them in silver, as follows: six hundred pieces of silver, and fifty pieces of gold. And all the silver amounted to one hundred pieces of gold each.
verses.27: And there were also forty pieces of gold for the decorations; one thousand pieces of silver, and two fine pieces of gold-colored jewelry.
verses.28: And she said to them, “You are holy to Jehovah. All these offerings and the gold and silver are also holy. They are meant for Jehovah, the God of your ancestors.”
verses.29: They shall keep them until they are brought before the priests, the Levites, and the priests of the fathers of Israel in Jerusalem. They shall be kept in the house of the LORD.
verses.30: And the priests and Levites received the money, gold, and other offerings from the weighbridge, so that they could be brought to Jerusalem, to the house of our God.
verses.31: And they traveled along the river Ahava for twelve months, in order to go to Jerusalem. Our God was with us, and He saved us from all kinds of harm and danger along the way.
verses.32: And Jerusalem was taken over, and they stayed there for three days.
verses.33: And on the fourth day, the money, gold, and all the utensils were counted in our temple, by the scribes of Oryah. With them were Eleazar son of Phinchas, and along with them were Yozebad son of Yeshua, and Noadya son of Binuy the Levite.
verses.34: In every measure and weight, it was recorded everything that was measured at that time.
verses.35: Those who came from the exiles brought offerings to the God of Israel. They offered twenty-two sheep for every man in Israel. There were also ninety-six goats, and seventy-seven rams. All these offerings were given to Jehovah.
verses.36: And they gave the king’s laws to the royal priests. They crossed the river, and then they carried the people and the temple along with them.
